title: W011 intake gap: normalized-replay diff sees one comparison_value per scenario, so Sheet1!B1 (cached 30) is never compared
description:
Typed gap found by DnaTreeCalc bead dtc-j7n8.12 (W011-W2b) on 2026-09-02.

EVIDENCE (retained, repo-relative): docs/test-runs/w011-a1-times-three-excel-compare-intake-baseline/. Both OxXlPlay W011 states (../OxXlPlay/states/excel/xlplay_w011_a1_times_three_pre_edit_001 and ..._dna_saved_001) validate (exit 0), replay (exit 0), and self-diff equivalent (exit 0). The cross-state diff pre_edit vs dna_saved (cross-state.diff.json, exit 1) reports EXACTLY ONE mismatch: worksheet_comparison_value 7.0 vs 10.0 (Sheet1!A1). It reports NOTHING for Sheet1!B1 (21 vs 30) even though both captures observed B1 directly: OxXlPlay normalized-replay v2 projects only the FIRST cell_value surface into comparison_views[comparison_value], the event normalized_family strings ('excel.surface.cell_value.direct:Sheet1!B1:comparison_value') no longer carry the value, and diff_summary ignores events once comparison_views are present. The per-surface values live in views/comparison-value.json (view_family comparison_value, surfaces[] with locator + oxfunc_value_types.aligned_json.v1 envelope), which validate-bundle indexes but no --kind loads.

CONSEQUENCE: an OxReplay 'equivalent' verdict over these states would be blind to the campaign's decisive requirement (post-save B1 cached = 30, not the stale 21). Do not produce a W011 verdict through the current normalized-replay path.

PROPOSED FIX (OxReplay-owned mechanics, no lane semantics): (a) add a loader kind (e.g. --kind oxxlplay-comparison-value-view) in oxreplay-core that consumes the declared per-surface comparison_value view and projects every surface as a node of a multi-node comparison family; (b) the existing per_node_value family already carries nodes[].{node_id, canonical_locator, comparison_value} but compares json-exact (per_node_value_json_exact) - decide whether per-node comparison_value envelopes should reuse comparison_value_equal (typed, tolerant of 10 vs 10.0) or stay json-exact; (c) pair with an OxXlPlay observation (docs/upstream/NOTES_FOR_OXXLPLAY.md) so multi-surface captures stop being lossy at the top-level view. Do NOT parse xlsx in OxReplay and do NOT hand-transcribe values into fixtures and call the result a verdict.

DEPENDS ON (other repo): a DnaTreeCalc-emitted replay-facing artifact for the same fixture (DnaTreeCalc bead filed from dtc-j7n8.12; see CURRENT_BLOCKERS.md BLK-REPLAY-005). Without a DNA-side producer artifact there is no left side to diff.
